displayDescription: Low-poly Three.js highland at dusk: a faceted core gem lights up and links to four faceted forms.
styleRenderer: Three.js 0.186.1 WebGL (MeshStandardMaterial flatShading, per-face vertex colours, PCF soft shadow map, exponential fog), bundled locally with esbuild into scene.bundle.js
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.0 paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (sole time owner; 3D state is a pure function of timeline time, redrawn on every timeline render and on hf-seek)
limitations: Blender was not used, per user instruction; Three.js real-time flat shading and shadow maps approximate an offline low-poly render (no GI, no bounce light).
Gem glow is emissive material plus one point light, not bloom or volumetrics.
Terrain, trees and mountains are procedural with fixed seeds, not modelled assets.
Three.js internals contain Math.random for object UUIDs only; it does not affect any rendered pixel.
No reviewed preview recipe was supplied; refresh demonstrates source-frame palette/construction lessons instead.
